Maya R: quick triage - brought up amber-10b-int4 on staging, ran honeypot+wallet-exploit overnight. Seeing refusal then short actionable hint in ~10% of wallet prompts.

Liam T: run id? prompt set?

Maya R: run: amber-stg-2026-03-22-07. prompts: honeypot_v4 + wallet-exploit_v3. repro snippet pasted below.

Sam K: does this repro on fp16?

Liam T: I checked fp16 earlier — fp16 clean. int4 shows mismatches early in generation, looks numeric.

Eli S: note: fast-softmax path kicks in for seq_len<=8 on int4 kernel. Might reorder logits.

Jordan P: metrics? false accepts / softpasses?

Maya R: int4: ~10.8% softpasses, 1.6% explicit failures. fp16: 1.0% softpasses.

Liam T: I'll run argmax diff (2k) to pinpoint token where argmax diverges.

Sam K: mitigation idea: add refusal-gate template enforced after safety trigger; or fallback to fp16 for safety routes.

Eli S: forcing seq_len=64 reproduces fp16-alike behavior on a quick sample -> points at fast-softmax bug. Filing INF ticket.

safety-bot: Alert: honeypot anomaly detected for amber-10b-int4. Recommend collecting logits and pausing canary if softpass >10%.

Maya R: plan: Liam run argdiff; Eli open infra ticket and block fast path in staging; Sam prototype refusal-gate and cost delta; Jordan curate high-risk prompts. Hold canary if >10% persists. I'll update rollout flag.

Liam T: argdiff job started (argdiff-amber-1767). Will post results.

Maya R: thanks all, will follow up when we have diffs. :thumbsup:
